notes.title: Momo's Mansion 3.06 New Patch
notes.content:
Hello, my friends!

Today, we have fixed a small programming issue with riding the Waterslide. Before, if you rode the Kitty Cat Waterslide, the walking animation would keep stepping which Momo appeared to "dance". Now, it goes back to the default correct way. CELEBRATION!

Another fix (and total oversight on our part), is located in the Toy Room in which the PRO CERTIFICATE that costs 100 tickets is now lowered to 99 (as you cannot get 100 of a item, the maximum is 99 so it wouldn't work before!). This was a issue but has now been rectified!! MEOW!

Additionally, we added the WORLD MAP by Fast Travel Maps located at the Mansion Merchant for a single Kitty Coin (that is viewable in the game). Immense thank you to Fast Travel Maps for doing an amazing job and detailed job in creating this!! 

THANK YOU, for the support my friends and I hope you have an amazing 2024!!

GAMEOW ON!


-Necro-
--NecroCaticGames--

notes.title: Update 3.05
notes.content:
We updated the game today with Controller Configuration and Keyboard Configuration so you can map the controller or keyboard to whatever you want.

The game developer suggests WASD default layout and it will have the ARROW KEYS move the character as well!!

We hope you enjoy playing the game, it is currently 50% off (or 55% off with the bundle) for the Steam Winter Sale!!!

Have a great evening,


-Necro-

notes.title: 3.03 Released.
notes.content:
Heeey all!  I hope everyone is having an amazing day! We added some new enemies to the game in version 3.03 but will keep it quite general to avoid spoilers!!  

-Added another boss in the Catacombs. Caution on this one, it's not for the lower levels...

-In the "Cat Canal" land areas (both sides) you will find "Cat Hunter Garden Dwarf" and "Cat Hunter Warrior Dwarf". Your party could face MULTIPLE enemies at once.

-You will also find a new dungeon in that area (Cat Canal) that has a new enemy (there is a different version of that certain enemy as well). 

-Inside the Mountain, you will be able to battle a new creation!!! 

-Inside the farm you can rumble with 2 versions of a certain character. For the first encounter, just talk to the bat! ... To start the next fight just search the same spot!

-Adjusted the tent bug to drop XP now!

-Fluffy's Arena in "The Green Mountains" now gives you a prompt before the next round so you can back out (to heal / save etc).

Fixed a couple small stuff and probably added other things. The game now has over 100 maps! We hope you enjoy playing it!



-NCG-

notes.title: 3.02 (Pre-release)
notes.content:
Added a "Toy Room" in the Mansion which has 2 different carpets and spawn a variety of enemies including (but not limited to) Surface to Surface Missile System, Toy Attack Chopper, Toy F-16C Fighting Falcon and 4 other enemies. All drop "Toy Tokens" and can be exchanged for a unique Certificate if you have 100 of them. You can also put 10 "Toy Parts" OR 10 "Big Toy Parts" (drop depending on the enemy) into the toy boss for some EXP. 

We hope you enjoy playing Momo's Mansion!

notes.title: 3.0 is here!
notes.content:

Attached is a screenshot of a Tiger doing a pounce on a Salmon. 

Have a wonderful day!!!
